title: Replace cloneJSON with structuredClone?
instruction: A pull request proposes replacing `cloneJSON` with the built-in `structuredClone` in src/session.js because it is 'faster and handles Dates'. Evaluate the change for the session objects this code actually handles: list every behavioural difference that matters here, say whether the change is safe to merge as is, and support the decisive point with code locations (and a quick run if useful). Do not modify files.
